help.title: HOW TO PLAY
help.body:
You landed at the Moon's south pole. Grow the base until Development reaches 60.

- The Sun stays low and circles the sky in ~10 minutes. Shadows move!
- Solar panels stop in shadow. Batteries cover the dark time.
- Ice hides in the dark crater. Carry it back (watch your suit O2), or build an ice drill there.
- Life support makes water and oxygen from ice. The greenhouse makes food.
- Radiation events: go indoors. Without an Earth link, alerts do not arrive.
- Earth sets for half of each month. Relay satellites keep the link.
